articles.title: New propulsion system to boost submarines’ staying power under water almost ready: DRDO chief
articles.summary: DRDO Chief Dr. Samir V. Kamat announced that a new indigenous propulsion system for submarines is nearing completion. This advanced technology aims to significantly enhance the underwater endurance and stealth capabilities of Indian submarines, reducing their reliance on frequent surface charging. Such advancements are crucial for bolstering India's naval power and strategic defence readiness, marking a significant step towards self-reliance in critical defence technologies.

articles.title: pg-raggraph added to PyPI
articles.summary: pg-raggraph introduces a PostgreSQL-native solution for advanced data management, integrating vector search, full-text search, and knowledge-graph traversal within a single SQL query. This innovation enables complex data operations using existing PostgreSQL infrastructure, eliminating the need for separate specialized databases. It streamlines database management and enhances analytical capabilities, promoting efficiency with familiar tools.

articles.title: Jenna Bush Hager Cries On-Air During Relatable Motherhood Admission
articles.summary: Jenna Bush Hager, the Today anchor and mother of three, openly discussed the emotional challenges of balancing her career as a working mom in New York City. She candidly shared her experiences managing family life with husband Henry Hager and their children Mila, Poppy, and Hal, highlighting the universal struggles faced by many working parents.

articles.title: From sea control to seabed control
articles.summary: Undersea cables in a contested region went dark, severely disrupting financial transactions, communications, and military coordination. Occurring without declared hostilities, this incident highlights critical vulnerabilities in global infrastructure and potential hybrid warfare tactics. It underscores the strategic importance of protecting vital underwater networks for national security and economic stability.

articles.title: mcp-omniplan-jtr added to PyPI
articles.summary: This article outlines controlling OmniPlan 4 project management software on macOS using natural language commands via LLM agents like Claude. Users can instruct the agent to create milestones or link tasks effortlessly. This integration streamlines complex project planning, enhancing productivity and intuitiveness through AI-driven software control, marking an advancement in intelligent tech solutions.
